hook_text: The full Moon is bright enough to cast your shadow. But does it make any light at all?
clip_script: Full moon night in Giyani. Is the Moon a lamp? Shine a torch on a soccer ball in the dark: the ball lights up, but it makes no light of its own. The Sun is the torch, the Moon is the ball! Now look through binoculars. Craters, punched by rocks from space. Mountains, high and rough. Dark plains of old, hard lava. And no wind or rain to wipe them away.
visual_style: Whiteboard torch shining on a ball, then a big Moon with labelled craters, mountains and dark plains.
mood: Calm night-time wonder, with a surprise answer.
pacing: Question, quick demonstration, then three features one by one.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and look for the dark plains on the next bright Moon.
